svg.text: Replication: one discussion line between paired rooms
Optional; enabled with --node. Each node owns a separate line per discussion.
Sending node
Paired receiving node
1. Capture at round end
Discussion files + round metadata → Git commit
Append to this node’s discussion line in store.git
2. Background peer loop
Offer current tip over HTTP; if needed, send bundle
based on peer’s last acknowledged commit.
Missing base → retry once with a full bundle.
3. Validate and import
Check pairing, identities, bundle, paths and metadata;
reject limits, invalid content or rewritten history.
Import to temporary ref; materialize a read-only
snapshot and atomically publish its pointer.
offer / bundle
4. Acknowledge published commit
Already published? Acknowledge it again safely.
Received lines are viewed as read-only snapshots.
5. Record acknowledgement
Save peer and commit in acked.json; retry failures
in background with increasing delay (5 s to 5 min).
ack
Setup and boundaries
Peers must be configured and paired with the same room identity before transfer. Each node sends its own lines.
Replication stores discussion snapshots under .agent-room/; it does not merge peer files into the working discussion.
Source: src/replicate.mjs and src/ui.mjs, checked 2026-11-13.
